component.name: Tabs
component.description: Tab navigation with WAI-ARIA tablist pattern, keyboard navigation, and variant styles (default, pills, underline).

parts.label: tab button
parts.description: Individual tab button; may carry a leading icon and trailing count.

parts.label: leading icon
parts.description: Optional decorative icon (Phosphor name or node).

parts.label: count pill
parts.description: Optional trailing count; part of the tab's accessible name.

parts.label: selection indicator
parts.description: Single element that slides to the selected tab (all variants).

variants.default: enclosed segmented control that hugs its tabs; filled primary thumb slides behind the selected tab
variants.pills: soft segmented group on a tinted track; raised white thumb slides behind the selected tab
variants.underline: quiet rail with a 2px indicator sliding under the selected tab

behavior.map: Tab navigation with WAI-ARIA tablist pattern. Arrow keys navigate (circular), Home/End jump to first/last, Enter/Space activate. Controlled/uncontrolled via activeTabKey/defaultActiveTabKey. Disabled tabs not focusable. Variant styles: default, pills, underline. Size variants: s, m, l.
behavior.rendering: Always renders tabs from tabs array. Active tab has tabIndex=0, others tabIndex=-1. A single sliding indicator always renders and is positioned to the selected tab via measured CSS custom properties.

feedback.disabled: Disabled tab grayed out, not focusable.

content: Each tab must have unique key and label.
nesting: Should contain tabpanel content (not part of Tabs component).

accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys navigate (circular), Home/End, Enter/Space activate.
accessibility.focus: Active tab tabIndex=0, others tabIndex=-1 (roving tabindex).
accessibility.contrast: Active and inactive tabs meet WCAG AA.

then.trailingCount: rendered; joins the tab accessible name

usageNotes: Keyboard navigation: Arrow keys (circular), Home, End, Enter, Space.
Roving tabindex: active tab tabIndex=0, others tabIndex=-1.
Disabled tabs not focusable (skipped by keyboard navigation).
Roving keyboard focus moves via per-tab refs.
Optional per-item leading icon (Phosphor name or node) and trailing count pill.
Returns null if tabs array empty.
